purpose: The reviewed list of SQL files (supabase/proposed/*.sql and every file named by a docs/reviews/*/apply-plan.json, except the two CL-16 files) that mention public.nodes or the rule guard. scripts/run-g1-rule-guard-sql-test.sh fails when a file outside this list mentions them, so a new proposal that reads or writes the rule tree cannot appear without a review of its order against CL-16. Reviewed 13.11.2026 by reading each file; the M0 files (the 23 files of the M0 apply plan at PR #1321 commit 4a406fed2) and the CL-13 files do not mention the rule tree and are therefore not listed. Evidence for the two writers: cl16-order-evidence/.
